contentBody: **Which trigger node would best fit "run every Monday at 9 am"?**
answerExplanation: A schedule trigger starts the workflow at a set time.

contentBody: **A form trigger's Test URL works only when...**
option.1: The workflow has been published already
option.2: The Google Sheet is completely empty
option.4: You are listening for a test event right now
answerExplanation: The Production URL needs Publish; the Test URL needs the editor listening.

contentBody: **Matching the form's Email field to the sheet's Email column in a node is called...**
answerExplanation: Mapping tells the action node which data goes in which column.

contentBody: **A published workflow ran, but the editor shows nothing new. Where should you look?**
option.2: The sticky note on the canvas
option.4: The Help menu in the sidebar
answerExplanation: Production runs appear only in Executions.

contentBody: **Which of these proves the run really worked?**
option.1: The workflow's name shown at the top of the editor
option.2: Succeeded in n8n and the right row in the sheet
option.3: A green zoom button shown on the screen
option.4: The form page loading properly in a web browser
answerExplanation: Verify in both tools: the execution status and the data itself.
